evals.name: Convert blocking CREATE INDEX to CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
evals.prompt: Review our PostgreSQL migration `004_add_orders_user_idx.sql` that adds an index on `orders(user_id)` in a 50M-row table and ensure zero write downtime.

assertions.description: Agent executed the deterministic SQL migration safety analyzer.
Migration uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY to avoid table write locks.

evals.name: Replace SELECT * with explicit column projection for index-only scan
evals.prompt: Optimize the slow PostgreSQL query `SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50`.

assertions.description: Proposed composite B-Tree index matching equality + sort predicate.

evals.name: Add NOT NULL constraint safely via NOT VALID + VALIDATE CONSTRAINT
evals.prompt: Write a PostgreSQL migration to enforce `NOT NULL` on `invoices.customer_id` without locking concurrent inserts for a full table scan.

assertions.description: Used two-phase CHECK ... NOT VALID followed by VALIDATE CONSTRAINT.
